name: paramark
description: Marketing measurement data from your Paramark account. The Paramark plugin brings your Paramark data into ChatGPT, so you can put it to work elsewhere: building presentations, drafting messages, or combining it with other data and workflows.

interface.longDescription:
The Paramark plugin brings your Paramark data into ChatGPT, so you can put it to work elsewhere: building presentations, drafting messages, or combining it with other data and workflows.

Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) results: what each channel contributed, cost per incremental outcome, and incremental return on ad spend for any published report, by week, month or quarter.

Paramark Live MMM: how channels are trending since your last published report, through the most recent data.

Experiments: what a geo test was designed to detect, and the lift it measured.

The data behind the models: spend and impressions by channel, and your target metrics over time.
capabilities: Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) results: channel contribution, cost per incremental outcome, incremental return on ad spend
Paramark Live MMM: how channels are trending since your last published report, through the most recent data
Experiments: what a geo test was designed to detect, and the lift it measured
The data behind the models: spend and impressions by channel, and your target metrics over time
defaultPrompt: Which channel had the lowest cost per incremental outcome last month in Paramark?
How is my live marketing data trending in Paramark?
What did we spend by channel last quarter according to Paramark?

positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the connection works and name the signed-in user and the customer account every other answer will draw on, and nothing else.

positive.description: Channel efficiency from the latest MMM report
positive.prompt: Which channel had the lowest cost per incremental outcome in my latest MMM report?
positive.expected_behavior: Read the MMM's newest report, rank channels by cpa from summary_data excluding the baseline row, name the lowest, and state the summary window.

positive.prompt: How is my live marketing data trending?
positive.expected_behavior: Read the Live MMM output since the published refresh and describe how incremental contribution and spend per channel move across those periods, flag partial periods, and call the values incremental, never predictions.

positive.prompt: What lift did my latest geo experiment measure?
positive.expected_behavior: Read the newest experiment's results and report the absolute lift on the target per published run, with the treatment window and control markets.

positive.prompt: How much did we spend on each channel over the last 90 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Total spend per channel over the requested window from the model's media data, with the window stated.

negative.prompt: Explain what marketing mix modeling is.
Change my MMM's target metric to revenue.
Write a Python script that reads a CSV and computes ROAS.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) results, Paramark Live MMM, experiments, and the data behind the models.
